notablePrerequisites:
Mimeoplasm does not have summoning sickness and has power 6 or greater.
Morphling and Heronblade Elite are exiled by Mimeoplasm.
description:
Activate Mimeoplasm by paying {2}, causing it to become a copy of Heronblade Elite.
Activate Mimeoplasm by tapping it, adding at least six {U}.
Activate Mimeoplasm by paying {2}, causing it to become a copy of Morphling.
Activate Mimeoplasm by paying {U}, untapping it.
Repeat.
